status: specified before crossed training and before outcome inspection

training_design.initial_states: the ten original main-cohort initializations per dataset, each reused for every shuffle level
training_design.analysis_guard: no real analysis before a complete validated 150-run manifest and root authorization

weight_distance.definition: Canonical hidden-neuron gauge, one shared unit norm for W0/W1, joint Hungarian permutation, total Frobenius distance
weight_distance.identity_policy: all compared network pairs use the same blind distance calculation

primary.endpoint: E20 cross-shuffle end-to-end retrieval of initial identity
primary.datasets: one primary test per dataset; Holm family size three
primary.comparisons: all 20 ordered pairs of distinct shuffle levels; 10 query identities and 10 candidate identities in each comparison
primary.statistic: mean average-tie correct-candidate rank, first averaged over comparisons for each initialization and then over ten initializations; smaller is better
primary.null: For every Monte Carlo draw, independently relabel initialization identities within shuffle levels 2-5 and hold shuffle level 1 fixed. The same per-level bijection is used in every comparison involving that level.
primary.mapping_convention: p[s,label] is the physical initialization index assigned to common label in shuffle s; a matched pair has physical indices p[source,label] and p[target,label]. Equivalently the target for physical query i is p[target,inverse(p[source])[i]].
primary.p_value: one-sided add-one Monte Carlo probability of mean rank at most the observation
primary.jackknife: delete one initialization and all five associated training runs, rerank nine candidates, calculate SE for rank_score=(n-mean_rank)/(n-1), and transform intervals to the full ten-candidate scale
primary.ci_scope: variation across ten initializations, conditional on the five selected shuffle levels; not 50 independent initializations
primary.shuffle_sensitivity: separate leave-one-shuffle estimates, without treating overlapping comparisons as independent replicates

secondary.final_hidden_representations: Also construct the complete E20 50x50 raw-hidden 1-minus-biased-centered-linear-CKA matrix on the same hashed original 3000-example probe. Apply the same cross-shuffle initialization retrieval, cross-initialization shuffle retrieval, factor-block nulls, block jackknives, and distance contrasts. All representational endpoints are secondary/exploratory; the primary weight metric does not change. No matching of hidden features and no use of initial representations for this endpoint.
secondary.end_to_initial: All 21 checkpoints: 50 queries against 10 initial candidates; average each initialization over its five shuffles. Null uses one candidate-initialization bijection consistently across all five queries of each initial identity. E0 is sanity only.
secondary.shuffle_retrieval: E20 end-to-end retrieval of shuffle identity across all 90 ordered pairs of distinct initialization blocks, with five candidates. Independently relabel shuffle identities within initialization blocks 2-10 while block 1 is fixed. Jackknife deletes a complete shuffle level across all ten initializations; intervals are conditional on the selected initializations.
secondary.initialization_distance_contrast: mean(different initialization, different shuffle) minus mean(same initialization, different shuffle), tested with the primary initialization-label null
secondary.shuffle_distance_contrast: mean(different initialization, different shuffle) minus mean(different initialization, same shuffle), tested with the shuffle-label null
secondary.distance_inference: whole initialization or shuffle blocks, respectively; individual network-pair distances are not independent replicates
secondary.performance: For accuracy and loss at every checkpoint, decompose the complete 10x5 table into additive initialization SS, shuffle SS, and interaction/residual SS. One outcome per cell means interaction and residual cannot be separated; no ANOVA p-values.
secondary.aggregation: equal mean across the three fixed dataset strata; independent within-dataset null draws and sum of within-stratum jackknife variances; secondary summary, not another primary family
secondary.interpretation: The crossed design separates sensitivity to initial weights and batch ordering within the specified training protocol. Identifiability and geometric separation are distinct; a nonsignificant retrieval result does not prove zero influence.

seeds.generator: numpy.random.RandomState; iid uniform bijections with replacement; common null mappings across related statistics and checkpoints

ties_and_intervals.ties: exact saved float64 distances; average ranks and fractional top1 credit
ties_and_intervals.top1: chance-corrected before jackknife when candidate count changes; returned to full-candidate scale
ties_and_intervals.mrr: reciprocal average ranks; exact chance is the average reciprocal rank over all candidate cells, including ties
ties_and_intervals.ci: normal observed estimate plus/minus 1.95996 SE, unclipped; boundary-perfect estimates may give degenerate jackknife intervals
ties_and_intervals.multiplicity: Holm only for the three prespecified E20 initialization-retrieval endpoints; all other p-values exploratory
